--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local PlotBuilder = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlotBuilder"))
local Tycoon = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Tycoon"))

-- Remotes
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTES_FOLDER)
if not remotes then
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = Config.REMOTES_FOLDER
	f.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	remotes = f
end
if not (remotes :: Instance):FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY) then
	local ev = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	ev.Name = Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY
	ev.Parent = remotes
end

-- World
local base = PlotBuilder.buildBase()
ForgeTelemetry.count("map_built", 1)

-- No SpawnLocation is created: Instance.new("SpawnLocation") adds a default Decal that
-- loads an unapproved asset and logs a warning. Characters are teleported to their plot
-- on every CharacterAdded (including respawns), so a spawn object is not needed.
local _ = base

type PlayerState = {
	index: number,
	plot: any,
	tycoon: any,
	counted: boolean,
	conns: { RBXScriptConnection },
}

local states: { [Player]: PlayerState } = {}
local slots: { [number]: Player? } = {}

local function nextFreeSlot(): number?
	for i = 1, Config.MAX_PLOTS do
		if slots[i] == nil then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function removePlot(plot: any)
	pcall(function()
		local parts: { Instance } = {}
		for _, key in { "conveyor", "collector", "dropperButton", "conveyorButton", "dropperSlot2" } do
			local p = plot[key]
			if typeof(p) == "Instance" then
				table.insert(parts, p)
			end
		end
		if type(plot.droppers) == "table" then
			for _, d in plot.droppers do
				if typeof(d) == "Instance" then
					table.insert(parts, d)
				end
			end
		end
		local container = parts[1] and parts[1].Parent
		if
			container
			and container ~= Workspace
			and (container:IsA("Model") or (container:IsA("Folder") and container.Name ~= "Plots" and container.Name ~= "TycoonPlots"))
		then
			container:Destroy()
		else
			for _, p in parts do
				p:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function teleport(player: Player, state: PlayerState, character: Model)
	local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if state.plot == nil or states[player] ~= state then
		return
	end
	character:PivotTo(state.plot.spawnCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	if not state.counted then
		state.counted = true
		ForgeTelemetry.count("plot_assigned", 1)
	end
end

local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
	if states[player] then
		return
	end

	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not ls then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "leaderstats"
		folder.Parent = player
		ls = folder
	end
	if not (ls :: Instance):FindFirstChild("Cash") then
		local cash = Instance.new("IntValue")
		cash.Name = "Cash"
		cash.Value = 0
		cash.Parent = ls
	end

	local index = nextFreeSlot()
	if not index then
		player:Kick("Server is full")
		return
	end
	slots[index] = player

	local state: PlayerState = { index = index, plot = nil, tycoon = nil, counted = false, conns = {} }
	states[player] = state

	local okPlot, plot = pcall(PlotBuilder.buildPlot, index)
	if not okPlot then
		warn("Plot build failed: " .. tostring(plot))
		states[player] = nil
		slots[index] = nil
		return
	end
	state.plot = plot
	state.tycoon = Tycoon.new(player, plot)

	table.insert(state.conns, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		teleport(player, state, character)
	end))
	if player.Character then
		local character = player.Character
		task.spawn(teleport, player, state, character)
	end
end

local function cleanupPlayer(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	states[player] = nil
	for _, c in state.conns do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	if state.tycoon then
		pcall(function()
			state.tycoon:destroy()
		end)
	end
	if state.plot then
		removePlot(state.plot)
	end
	if slots[state.index] == player then
		slots[state.index] = nil
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(cleanupPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end

## Problem
Playtest critique:
- The visible header requires only PlotBuilder and Tycoon, never PlazaBuilder or PlotClaimService. It has its own slots/states/teleport/removePlot logic, so players are teleported onto a plot on join. That contradicts the spec: players spawn in the plaza, claim a plot via a gate or the 20s auto-claim, and cubes_dropped stays 0 until then. The counters 'plaza_built', 'themes_built', 'plots_claimed' and 'auto_claims' would likely never fire. (hint: Make Game.server.luau a thin bootstrap. Build the plaza and plots (PlotBuilder plus PlazaBuilder), call PlotClaimService.init with the plot list, and delete the per-player slot assignment and teleport-to-plot code. Spawn players at the plaza (SpawnLocation or PivotTo the plaza center). Start the Tycoon only from PlotClaimService.claim. Bump 'map_built' once.)

## Context
Game: Cube Cash Tycoon - Watch cubes roll down your conveyor, cash in, and buy droppers and speed upgrades to grow your tiny factory!
Core loop: Each player gets a bright plot with a dropper that spawns a 1-cash cube every 2 seconds onto a conveyor. The conveyor carries cubes to a collector at the end, and the server adds each cube's value to the player's Cash leaderstat and destroys the cube. Two buy pads sit off to the side of the walking area: a second dropper for 25 cash and a faster conveyor for 50 cash. Touching a pad with enough cash buys the upgrade once, so income climbs and the numbers go up.
Acceptance: The map (baseplate and the player's plot with dropper, conveyor, collector and two buy pads) is built from parts at startup and the 'map_built' counter is 1; The player spawns on their plot within a few seconds, and 'plot_assigned' is 1; 'cubes_dropped' increases within the first 2 seconds and keeps increasing roughly every 2 seconds; 'cubes_collected' increases as cubes reach the collector, and the Cash leaderstat rises; Touching a buy pad with insufficient cash does nothing; with enough cash it deducts the cost once and increments 'dropper_bought' or 'conveyor_bought'; The HUD shows the current Cash and updates as it changes; Walking from spawn does not trigger the buy pads accidentally, and the cube count stays under the cap; No errors or warnings appear in the output; At startup the plaza (stone tiles, fountain, lamp posts, trees) and 6 plots in a ring exist; 'plaza_built' is 1, 'themes_built' is 6 and 'map_built' is 1; Each plot has a distinct theme floor material and color plus 3-5 decoration props (lollipops, lava cracks, crystals, palm trees, neon strips, cacti), and no part is default grey; rails, dropper bodies and pads use theme colors; Players spawn in the plaza, not on a plot, and cubes_dropped stays 0 until a plot is claimed; Each free plot shows a glowing gate with a BillboardGui reading 'Claim <Theme> Plot'; Walking onto a gate claims that plot: the sign shows the player's name, the gate hides, 'plots_claimed' and 'plot_assigned' increase, and 'cubes_dropped' starts rising about every 2 seconds; A player who does not claim within 20 seconds is auto-claimed to the nearest free plot ('auto_claims' increases) and the dropper starts

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Config: any = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"))
local ForgeTelemetry: any = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local PlotBuilder: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlotBuilder"))
local PlazaBuilder: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlazaBuilder"))
local PlotClaimService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlotClaimService"))

	local ev = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	ev.Name = Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY
	ev.Parent = remotes

-- Calls the first function found under any of the given names.
local function callFirst(module: any, names: { string }, ...: any): (boolean, any)
	if type(module) ~= "table" then
		return false, nil
	end
	for _, name in names do
		local fn = module[name]
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
			if not ok then
				warn(name .. " failed: " .. tostring(result))
			end
			return ok, result
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

-- World: base, plaza, plots
callFirst(PlotBuilder, { "buildBase" })

local plazaCenter = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
local okPlaza, plaza = callFirst(PlazaBuilder, { "buildPlaza", "build", "create" })
if okPlaza and plaza ~= nil then
	if typeof(plaza) == "CFrame" then
		plazaCenter = (plaza :: CFrame).Position
	elseif typeof(plaza) == "Vector3" then
		plazaCenter = plaza :: Vector3
	elseif type(plaza) == "table" then
		local c = plaza.spawnCFrame or plaza.centerCFrame or plaza.center or plaza.spawn
		if typeof(c) == "CFrame" then
			plazaCenter = c.Position
		elseif typeof(c) == "Vector3" then
			plazaCenter = c
		end
	end
end

local plotCount: number = Config.PLOT_COUNT or Config.MAX_PLOTS or 6
local plots: { any } = {}
for i = 1, plotCount do
	local ok, plot = pcall(PlotBuilder.buildPlot, i)
	if ok and plot ~= nil then
		table.insert(plots, plot)
	else
		warn("Plot build failed: " .. tostring(plot))
	end
end

ForgeTelemetry.count("map_built", 1)

callFirst(PlotClaimService, { "init", "start", "setup" }, plots)

-- Players
local function hasClaimedPlot(player: Player): boolean
	if type(PlotClaimService) == "table" then
		local getter = PlotClaimService.getPlot or PlotClaimService.getPlotFor
		if type(getter) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(getter, player)
			if ok and result ~= nil then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return player:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") ~= nil or player:GetAttribute("ClaimedPlot") ~= nil
end

local function spawnAtPlaza(player: Player, character: Model)
	local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if hasClaimedPlot(player) then
		return
	end
	local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-6, 6), 4, math.random(-6, 6))
	character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(plazaCenter + offset))
end

local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not ls then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "leaderstats"
		folder.Parent = player
		ls = folder
	end
	if not (ls :: Instance):FindFirstChild("Cash") then
		local cash = Instance.new("IntValue")
		cash.Name = "Cash"
		cash.Value = 0
		cash.Parent = ls
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		spawnAtPlaza(player, character)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		local character = player.Character
		task.spawn(spawnAtPlaza, player, character)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end
